avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer significantly reduces voriconazole levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before voriconazole therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer decreases voriconazole plasma concentrations by up to 75%
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; use alternative antituberculous agent if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce voriconazole bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; dietary garlic acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease voriconazole efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may increase voriconazole levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; maintain consistent intake if used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases voriconazole plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice during therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay voriconazole absorption and reduce peak serum levels
caution_foods.action: Take voriconazole 1 hour before or 1 hour after meals for optimal absorption; consistent timing recommended

monitoring_notes: Voriconazole has narrow therapeutic index and significant CYP metabolism; monitor for hepatotoxicity, visual disturbances, and QT prolongation. Therapeutic drug monitoring recommended due to high inter-individual variability and potential for drug interactions via CYP3A4, CYP2C19, and CYP2C9 inhibition.
